d:
Tampa Bay Rays fight back to stay alive in Game 4 thriller!
Facing elimination, the Tampa Bay Rays showed true postseason grit to edge the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3 at Tropicana Field! Clutch timely hitting and ice-cold relief pitching in the late innings denied Milwaukee the sweep. With this thrilling 4-3 victory, Tampa Bay cuts the World Series deficit to 3-1!
